sentences.text: Ava Marie DuVernay -LRB- -LSB- ˈeɪvə_ˌdjuːvərˈneɪ -RSB- born August 24 , 1972 -RRB- is an American director , screenwriter , film marketer , and film distributor .	American	United States	film marketer	film marketing	film distributor	film distributor

At the 2012 Sundance Film Festival , DuVernay won the Best Director Prize for her second feature film Middle of Nowhere , becoming the first African-American woman to win the award .	American	United States	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival	Middle of Nowhere	Middle of Nowhere (2012 film)	African-American	African-American
For her work in Selma -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , DuVernay was the first black female director to be nominated for a Golden Globe Award .	Selma	Selma (film)	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award

With Selma , she was also the first black female director to have her film nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture , though she was not nominated for Best Director .	Selma	Selma (film)	Academy Award for Best Picture	Academy Award for Best Picture

In 2017 , she was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature for her film 13th -LRB- 2016 -RRB- .	Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature	Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature	13th	13th (film)

DuVernay 's next film , A Wrinkle in Time , reportedly has a budget exceeding $ 100 million , making DuVernay the first black woman to direct a live-action film with a budget of that size .	A Wrinkle in Time	A Wrinkle in Time (2018 film)
